purpose: Re-test the incremental recovery-gap AI lease against an otherwise identical fixed-reservation and bounded-AI policy under Confirm47's requalified 50 ms NRx admission and 35 ms AI socket timeout. The two ABBA seed pairs are a mechanism comparison, not the full channel-gate/queue-aware combined baseline.

execution.operational_requalification: 200 conventional-only releases with zero deadline misses

stopping_rule: Evaluate both seed/order pairs exactly once and report all failures. Do not add seeds or tune thresholds after reading outcomes.
interpretation_limit: The OFF condition already has atomic recovery reservation, a persistent MPS endpoint, single commit, and bounded AI between releases. This isolates only the incremental gap lease. With one cell and one endpoint, queue-aware endpoint choice and channel-gate policies are not tested; even a pass is not proof against the full prior-technique combination or a hard worst-case deadline guarantee.
